verdict.rationale: No dedicated export or data-portability feature is documented. The only route to extract data is the API: an endpoint returns all feedback posts for the organization, and webhooks stream events to your own backend. This is an indirect, do-it-yourself path that covers only some data types. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open formats (CSV/JSON dumps), coverage of all data types (conversations, help center, changelogs, users), offboarding guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
